controls.name: COMBO_PHY
controls.reason: Source-assigned AP-NS control relevant to future PCIe/NETC HSIO bring-up.

MISC_SI_INFO.model_policy: Return i.MX952 identity and baseline revision name only; physical device ID, fuse revision and part-number words remain zero until board evidence is captured.

MISC_CFG_INFO.model_policy: Return pinned mx952evk configuration identity, not a fabricated hardware mode-selector value.

MISC_BOARD_INFO.model_policy: Return i.MX952 EVK board identity with zero unmeasured board-specific attributes.

MISC_DISCOVER_BUILD_INFO.model_policy: Return deterministic model-build identity tied to the pinned NXP source commit, not an NXP production firmware build number.

implementation_policy: Do not advertise MISC to AP-S until a source-derived accessible message/resource contract for AP-S is established.
Do not expose device controls beyond explicit generated-config permissions.
COMBO_PHY state is a functional control model and does not claim PCIe/NETC PHY electrical equivalence.
MISC_SI_INFO must not impersonate physical fuse-derived values; unmeasured numeric silicon fields stay zero while the textual target identity is source-derived.
Extended controls, ROM passover, syslog, DDR info and detailed reset-reason semantics remain unimplemented until their source-derived data contracts are qualified.
